messages:
Maya Singh: Dropping a fresh proposal for the model catalog compare UI. main goals: make perf badges explicit, avoid ambiguous pin language, and ensure keyboard/voiceover flows. want quick feedback.
Ethan Wallace: On it. can you highlight the mobile constraints? compact rows are tight.
Maya Singh: Mobile: no legend space in header. idea: inline condensed legend below search that can expand, plus an always-available "?" icon opens a lightweight modal with full defs.
Priya Nair: Love that. also recommend we include a text label with the badge on mobile, e.g., "Latency: Low" rather than color-only.
Omar Khalid: From infra: metric definitions need to be explicit. Are badges based on median or p95? that'll change thresholds.
Maya Singh: Proposal: default to median, allow global toggle to p95 in the catalog toolbar. badges show tier + numeric value on hover; mobile tap shows numeric tooltip.
Sara Liu: Accessibility: color is secondary indicator only. add screen-reader-only text for tier + value, e.g., "Latency tier: Low. median 42ms." and make sure it's announced when focus moves to the badge.
Ethan Wallace: For the badge action: should badge open details or should the row? I prefer row click opens details; badge is a secondary action to open quick metrics popover. that helps mobile too.
Priya Nair: Agree. badge needs a 44px touch target on mobile. if we keep it small visually, extend hit area. add aria-label: "Open latency details for Model X".
Omar Khalid: Backend will add a pinned_strategy field: "static" or "follow_patch". we'll return pinned_strategy with the model listing so UI can render "Pinned — static" vs "Pinned — follows patch".
Maya Singh: Copy suggestions: replace "Pin version" with "Pin model version" and tooltip: "Pin this exact variant for comparison and rollout (static)". For follow_patch: "Pin follows patch (auto) — updates with latest patch releases."
Sara Liu: When pinned state toggles, ensure ARIA live region says "Version 2.1.0 pinned (static)" or "Unpinned". keyboard users won't notice visual-only changes otherwise.
Ethan Wallace: Focus order: filter controls -> search -> view toggle -> result list -> row actions -> details drawer. details drawer must trap focus and return focus to the triggering row.
Priya Nair: Microcopy: badges should avoid vague adjectives. suggest: "Latency: Low (<50ms)", "Latency: Medium (50–150ms)", "Latency: High (>150ms)". show exact median in tooltip.
Maya Singh: Legend language: short lines, no full sentences. e.g., "Low: median <50ms". We'll add a link to docs for full definitions.
Omar Khalid: Note: if customer switches metric to p95, we should apply the same tier names but show the metric type next to the badge: "Latency (p95): High". keep it explicit.
Sara Liu: Keyboard and screen reader checks: test NVDA and VoiceOver on macOS and iOS Safari. Also test TalkBack on Android for the mobile legend modal.
Ethan Wallace: Design question: should pinned rows float to the top of results? some users want that, others don't. maybe a toggle in the toolbar "Show pinned first".
Priya Nair: Good idea — keep it optional. When enabled, visually mark the pinned group with a subtle divider and "Pinned" label. ensure the divider has semantic role if needed.
Maya Singh: ux-bot: Updated prototype at https://www.figma.com/file/yyy/compare-ux. Auto contrast scan: 3 failures (badge text on colored background, modal close icon).
Maya Singh: Priya, can you take contrast pass on badge text and icon sizes? aim for 4.5:1 for small text.
Priya Nair: On it. I'll also add the visually-hidden summaries for screen readers and the aria-live announcement when pin toggles.
Omar Khalid: I'll add pinned_strategy to the API and a metric_type field (median/p95) per-catalog config. will create backend ticket and link here.
Sara Liu: Final nit: microcopy for the pin affordance: tooltip should read "Pin model version — preserves this exact build for compare and rollout". keep it under 8 words if possible.
Maya Singh: Next steps: Priya to update Figma and accessibility annotations, Omar to add API fields, Ethan to validate focus order in prototype. reconvene Friday 10am PT. thanks!
